mentions.name: 7coderwords
mentions.description: A tiny word puzzle web game for programmers and computer science nerds, built as a PWA that works offline. Puzzles are curated by hand, with graphics and tests created with Claude's help. Implemented in vanilla JavaScript using the Canvas API and Web Audio.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on new puzzles for my tiny word puzzle web game for programmers and computer science nerds.

It's a PWA and works offline. Tech: js, no libs, Canvas API, Web Audio, not vibe coded, but I did use Claude for graphics and tests. Puzzles curated by hand.
